memoryDecisions.reason: This revised goal requires constructing and checking a proton-transfer relation across changing species and partners. It does not require recalling a fixed catalogue of equations, numerical constants or exceptions. The one-proton relation is taught and independently demonstrated by particle/formula reasoning in the existing paired cases. A dedicated card would rehearse a label or rule while not evidencing the required construction and justification. No additional mandatory recall item is needed for this goal; preserve the separate existing pK card requirement.

The revised competence is to choose the correct conjugate ratio after a material balance and justify the approximation domain. Deriving or using the provided relation does not require a separate new hard-recall fact for this goal. The unchanged cases deliberately distinguish unchanged ratio, depleted reserve and invalid logarithms; a formula-recall card would not test those decisions. The existing canonical deck already has a Henderson-Hasselbalch recall card005/006 separation: card006 belongs to ordinary origin a449e874, while card005 remains the separate pK item for48115. Do not duplicate or reassign those cards to make this new wording look reviewed.

The goal text is unchanged; the negative-log definitions and compact pKS strength-order fact remain a narrow useful recall component. The actual deck has card005 with that content, the current kept/necessary card record names48115 as origin, and the unchanged memory goal refers to the same canonical deck and requires48115. This trace is preserved exactly. Full pK equilibrium comparison remains ordinary reasoning, and existing visibility evidence is reused without a new scope or runtime claim.

It is a teaching example, not a claim that all buffers obey the concentration formula exactly; the unchanged independent cases/profile assess the approximation limits. Absence of a full limits checklist in the image is not itself a defect.
